olist_customers_dataset: Table represents customer information and location (includes customer_id, customer_unique_id, customer_zip_code_prefix, customer_city, customer_state)
customer_id: Represents the unique identifier for each customer, datatype: VARCHAR, sample values: 94b975689c61872e24c36749bd542447, 386124a646dba2aaea281faab04634f9
customer_unique_id: Represents the unique identifier for each customer across orders, datatype: VARCHAR, sample values: bca18b5eeb716073cf391ceb2dacd6d2, b77e44fcd284241c32aec8dc63e392cc
customer_zip_code_prefix: Represents the zip code prefix of the customer's location, datatype: INT, sample values: 29024, 32260
customer_city: Represents the city where the customer is located, datatype: VARCHAR, sample values: vitoria, contagem
customer_state: Represents the state where the customer is located, datatype: VARCHAR, sample values: ES, MG
olist_geolocation_dataset: Table represents Brazilian zip codes and its lat/lng coordinates (includes geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng, geolocation_city, geolocation_state)
geolocation_zip_code_prefix: Represents the zip code prefix of Brazilian locations, datatype: integer, sample values: 86046, 32370
geolocation_lat: Represents the latitude coordinates of Brazilian locations, datatype: float, sample values: -23.34033425313053, -19.93387097305251
geolocation_lng: Represents the longitude coordinates of Brazilian locations, datatype: float, sample values: -51.14403909813019, -44.02634715518152
geolocation_city: Represents the city name corresponding to the zip code, datatype: string, sample values: 'londrina', 'contagem'
geolocation_state: Represents the state abbreviation for the Brazilian location, datatype: string, sample values: 'PR', 'MG'
olist_order_items_dataset: Table represents data about the items purchased within each order (includes order_id, order_item_id, product_id, seller_id, shipping_limit_date, price, freight_value)
order_id: alphanumeric identifier for each order, TEXT, sample values: '290fd15a601791489cc89d22dd315800', '615ae1b88a25a4ac47fbf55c9c847b6e'
order_item_id: identifier for each item within an order, INTEGER, sample values: 1, 2
product_id: identifier for each product, TEXT, sample values: '276e9ed23a30582d125743aaed57ed22', 'fa304c5424fd292aed9c35eb36d9f495'
seller_id: identifier for each seller, TEXT, sample values: '52f0fe436a347ddad7ed5f9aa4e27eaa', '609e1a9a6c2539919b8205cf7c4e6ff0'
shipping_limit_date: deadline for shipping the order, TEXT, sample values: '2018-03-19 18:15:36', '2018-08-14 13:55:18'
price: price of the item, FLOAT, sample values: 20.9, 64.99
freight_value: cost of shipping, FLOAT, sample values: 22.85, 19.65
olist_order_payments_dataset: Table represents orders payment options (includes order_id, payment_sequential, payment_type, payment_installments, payment_value)
order_id: Represents the unique identifier for each order, datatype: string, sample values: 'd2af9f29f103214f951dfb33055b8bd6', '78eda8cdf7d5a0f8b22ad393f0139981'
payment_sequential: Represents the sequence of payment for each order, datatype: integer, sample values: 1, 1
payment_type: Represents the type of payment used, datatype: string, sample values: 'credit_card', 'boleto'
payment_installments: Represents the number of installments for the payment, datatype: integer, sample values: 1, 1
payment_value: Represents the payment amount, datatype: float, sample values: 87.97, 129.49
olist_order_reviews_dataset: Table represents reviews made by customers after purchase (includes review_id, order_id, review_score, review_comment_title, review_comment_message, review_creation_date, review_answer_timestamp)
review_id: Unique identifier for each review, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: '06de6ba90c81c318f9f08196c369ded5', '3d7cb5e1cade7478b7591b7821b91fa4'
order_id: Unique identifier for each order, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: '8465a1ae25d801a0c2d8dbfeb425a6f6', '5c046e4039e459e61961dce13fdf1d7b'
review_score: The score given by the customer for the review, data type: INTEGER, sample values: 2, 5
review_comment_title: Title of the comment provided by the customer, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: None
review_comment_message: Detailed comment provided by the customer, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: 'Entrega em atraso', 'Comprei o produto e o mesmo chegou muito antes...'
review_creation_date: Date when the review was created, data type: DATETIME, sample values: '2018-03-23 00:00:00', '2017-11-01 00:00:00'
review_answer_timestamp: Timestamp of when the review was answered, data type: DATETIME, sample values: '2018-03-25 11:41:48', '2017-11-02 03:29:19'
olist_orders_dataset: Table represents core dataset containing order-level details linking all other datasets (includes order_id, customer_id, order_status, order_purchase_timestamp, order_approved_at, order_delivered_carrier_date, order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date)
order_id: unique identifier for each order, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: '00042b26cf59d7ce69dfabb4e55b4fd9', '6660735419b67a222968c81cd4e3fc9b'
customer_id: unique identifier for each customer, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: '58dbd0b2d70206bf40e62cd34e84d795', '986666beea9f9971afa44b4bcf1df7cc'
order_status: status of the order, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: 'delivered', 'delivered'
order_purchase_timestamp: timestamp when the order was made, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: '2017-02-04 13:57:51', '2017-10-16 11:28:49'
order_approved_at: timestamp when the order was approved, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: '2017-02-04 14:10:13', '2017-10-16 11:49:29'
order_delivered_carrier_date: timestamp when the order was delivered to the carrier, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: '2017-02-16 09:46:09', '2017-10-16 19:42:26'
order_delivered_customer_date: timestamp when the order was delivered to the customer, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: '2017-03-01 16:42:31', '2017-10-20 16:23:53'
order_estimated_delivery_date: estimated delivery date for the order, data type: VARCHAR, sample values: '2017-03-17 00:00:00', '2017-11-06 00:00:00'
olist_products_dataset: Table represents products sold by Olist (includes product_id, product_category_name, product_name_lenght, product_description_lenght, product_photos_qty, product_weight_g, product_length_cm, product_height_cm, product_width_cm)
product_id: unique identifier for each product, TEXT, sample values: 'e67307ff0f15ade43fcb6e670be7a74c', '081476f0ad46b45e23bbd0f3d1d4dd98'
product_category_name: category name of the product, TEXT, sample values: 'beleza_saude', 'utilidades_domesticas'
product_name_lenght: length of the product name in characters, FLOAT, sample values: 47.0, 43.0
product_description_lenght: length of the product description in characters, FLOAT, sample values: 1474.0, 554.0
product_photos_qty: quantity of photos associated with the product, FLOAT, sample values: 3.0, 2.0
product_weight_g: weight of the product in grams, FLOAT, sample values: 150.0, 175.0
product_length_cm: length of the product in centimeters, FLOAT, sample values: 43.0, 16.0
product_height_cm: height of the product in centimeters, FLOAT, sample values: 13.0, 12.0
product_width_cm: width of the product in centimeters, FLOAT, sample values: 14.0, 12.0
olist_sellers_dataset: Table represents Sellers (includes seller_id, seller_zip_code_prefix, seller_city, seller_state)
seller_id: unique identifier for each seller, TEXT, sample values: '5d043cd5512d4bd2f88e5ccdd5736c38', 'd20b021d3efdf267a402c402a48ea64b'
seller_zip_code_prefix: the first digits of the seller's zip code, INTEGER, sample values: 2710, 14940
seller_city: the city where the seller is located, TEXT, sample values: 'sao paulo', 'ibitinga'
seller_state: the state where the seller is located, TEXT, sample values: 'SP', 'PR'
product_category_name_translation: Table represents translating the product_category_name to English (includes product_category_name, product_category_name_english)
product_category_name: Represents the original product category name, datatype: VARCHAR, sample values: informatica_acessorios, cds_dvds_musicais
product_category_name_english: Represents the translated product category name to English, datatype: VARCHAR, sample values: computers_accessories, cds_dvds_musicals
